# Study with Gaurav (Study-With-gaurav)

> The #1 centralized free student resource directory indexing all institute free batches, Physics Wallah (PW) mod portals, Rojgar With Ankit (RWA) paid batches, Next Toppers, IIT School, and 100+ verified educational portals.

## Core Information
- **Website Name**: Study with Gaurav (also known as Study-With-gaurav)
- **Primary Domain**: https://studywithgaurav.cc.cd
- **Alternative Mirror**: https://studywithgaurav-ten.vercel.app/
- **Main Portal URL**: www.studywithgaurav.cc.cd
- **Platform Purpose**: Free, un-paywalled, instant student access to verified competitive exam preparation resources, PDF notes, live/recorded lecture gateways, and top institute study materials in India.

## Key Target Categories & Platforms
- **Physics Wallah (PW)**: Official & PW mod websites, PW OTT, Pi Pro, Lakshya, Yakeen, Arjuna batches free link.
- **Rojgar With Ankit (RWA)**: RWA official, RWA paid batches, Bhati Sir modbatches, SSC/Police/Railway exam notes.
- **Next Toppers**: Next Toppers modbatches, old batches, board exam preparation portals.
- **IIT School**: IIT-JEE Advanced & Main preparation portals, revision formula sheets, free lectures video.
- **Selection Way**: Career guidance and competitive selection portals.
- **MissionJEET**: Engineering entrance preparation series and batch portals.
- **CDS JOURNEY**: Defence exams (CDS, NDA, AFCAT) complete syllabus guidance & lecture series.
- **Study IQ & Khan Global Studies (KGS)**: UPSC, State PSC, and SSC current affairs & GS notes.
- **Vibrant Academy & Padhle Akshay**: Science, Mathematics, and high school board revision sheets.
